hypothesis_origin: Batch 19 passed paired annual-return evidence at 10 bps but failed high-cost advantage and Sharpe uncertainty
interpretation: retrospective cost-repair experiment; not final evidence

confidence_activation.current_month: at or above expanding prior 80th confidence percentile
confidence_activation.persistence: current and immediately prior monthly decisions must both be strong
confidence_activation.activated_weight: minimum of current and prior strong-tier weights
confidence_activation.risk_exit: immediate; persistence never delays a volatility cap or drawdown stop

cost_hurdle.input: buffered ML minus frozen-core weekly net return, each simulated at 100 bps
cost_hurdle.availability: realization date no later than current decision
cost_hurdle.activation_requirement: trailing mean excess return greater than zero

holding_buffer.membership_replacement_hurdle: challenger prediction must exceed the weakest incumbent by 0.25 times the current cross-sectional prediction IQR
holding_buffer.information: current out-of-fold prediction and lagged volatility only

promotion_gates.point_10bps: annual return and Sharpe greater than frozen core with no worse maximum drawdown
promotion_gates.paired_10bps: one-sided 95 percent lower Sharpe and annual-return differences both greater than zero
promotion_gates.point_100bps: annual return and Sharpe greater than frozen core
promotion_gates.turnover: buffered ML annual turnover lower than original ML and primary allocation turnover no greater than Batch 19
promotion_gates.calibration: active-minus-inactive future rank IC serial-block-bootstrap lower bound greater than zero
